entities.name: Nissanka Malla of Polonnaruwa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nissanka Malla, also known as Kirti Nissanka and Kalinga Lokaswara was a king of Polonnaruwa who ruled the country from 1187 to 1196. He is known for his architectural constructions such as the Nissanka Lata Mandapaya, Hatadage and Rankot Vihara, as well as for the refurbishment of old temples and irrigation tanks.
